name: @civ-clone/civ1-tileset-pixelart
description: An original, royalty-free 32px pixel-art tileset for civ.one, for the square, hexagonal and isometric grids, drawn by code from a written spec
author: dom111 <dom111@users.noreply.github.com>

scripts.build: node src/build.js pack tileset.json && node src/build.js pack-hex tileset-hex.json && node src/build.js pack-iso tileset-iso.json
scripts.previews: node tools/sheet-units.js previews/units.png && node tools/sheet-misc.js previews/misc.png && node tools/preview-map.js previews/map.png 2 && node tools/sheet-masks.js previews/terrain-joins.png mountains hills forest jungle swamp desert plains tundra arctic grassland river && node tools/preview-hex.js previews/hex-map.png 2 && node tools/preview-iso.js previews/iso-map.png 2
